impact: V2 helper/NVENC path confirmed as source. PipeWire delivers XR24 (BGRx, 4 bytes/pixel) via SHM on this system (DMA-BUF hard-fails every session). NVENC buffer is declared NV12 with locked_pitch=4096, but SHM frame_stride=15360. No BGRx→NV12 conversion exists in the helper. Raw XR24 bytes are pushed to an NV12-typed buffer — encoder misreads data producing deterministic striping with preserved geometry. Visual corruption is content-dependent (high horizontal color contrast makes it visible). Evidence: .story/handovers/evidence/2026-05-23-iss-014-dual-path-repro/v2/encode-boundary.log
title: Replay artifacts show deterministic vertical striping with preserved scene geometry
